---
title: "Stop / Start / Continue Feedback Form"
---

> Used in one-on-ones, retrospectives, and the annual operating review. Can be run anonymously for group-level climate feedback.

**Context (project / group / period):** _______________  **Date:** _______________
**Anonymous?** ☐ Yes ☐ No

## STOP — what should we stop doing?
- (behavior/process + why it isn't working)

## START — what should we start doing?
- (new behavior/process + expected benefit)

## CONTINUE — what's working that we should keep?
- (behavior/process worth protecting)

## One change I'd prioritize
-

> Synthesis (facilitator): themes + 1–2 committed changes + owners.
